sections.heading: Come Visit Us in San Pedro

blocks.html: Technically an area of Los Angeles, San Pedro is a walkable neighborhood with the feel of a small town. Along with friendly people and cultural diversity, there’s so many things to see and do. Downtown offers gorgeous murals, theaters, art galleries, museums and outstanding restaurants, pubs and breweries. The waterfront promenades, harbor and parks are ideal for discovering live music and activities such as boating, fishing, sailing and surfing.

blocks.html: Whether you’re visiting San Pedro for the sunshine and amazing beaches or a long-time local, We Roll Up is the perfect stop for focusing on health and happiness. We are extremely proud of our distinction as the first licensed cannabis dispensary in San Pedro. Open seven days per week, our location at 1705 S Gaffey Street welcomes California MMJ cardholders and recreational enthusiasts 21+ from across the country.

sections.heading: A Dispensary Rooted Between San Pedro and Palos Verdes

blocks.html: Picture the stretch of coastline that connects San Pedro to Palos Verdes: rolling hills, ocean overlooks, working harbors, and tight-knit neighborhoods where people know their corner stores by name. Somewhere between a morning hike along the bluffs and an evening spent unwinding at home, plenty of residents along this corridor find themselves wanting a trustworthy, legal place to shop for cannabis. That is exactly the need we set out to meet, and it is why so many folks traveling between these two communities make a point of stopping in.

blocks.html: A Dispensary Rooted Between San Pedro and Palos Verdes
blocks.text: A Dispensary Rooted Between San Pedro and Palos Verdes

blocks.html: As San Pedro’s first licensed cannabis dispensary, We Roll Up holds a unique position along this part of the coast. Being the first legal, licensed operation in the area means we carry a responsibility to set the standard, and we take that seriously by maintaining a safe, secure, and welcoming environment for everyone who walks through our doors. The Palos Verdes peninsula and San Pedro share a border and a rhythm, and we function as part of that local society rather than apart from it.

blocks.html: Our location matters to residents on both sides of that line. Whether you are coming down from the hills or up from the harbor, we sit conveniently within reach for a quick visit. We’re open seven days a week, which means your schedule rarely has to bend around ours. We also speak Spanish, with a Spanish-speaking team member always onsite, so language is never a barrier to getting the guidance you need.

blocks.html: How We Guide You Through the Menu
blocks.text: How We Guide You Through the Menu

blocks.html: Walking into a dispensary for the first time can feel like a lot, especially with the breadth of products available today. Our approach is consultative and unhurried. Our diverse, knowledgeable team takes the time to learn what you’re looking for, whether that’s relief, relaxation, focus, or simple enjoyment, and then matches you with options that fit. First-time patients and longtime aficionados receive the same attention.

blocks.html: Our hand-picked selection spans the full spectrum of what modern cannabis has to offer, all at affordable prices. From the casual weekend user to the dedicated connoisseur, there is something here worth exploring.

blocks.html: Serving the Wider Coastal Community
blocks.text: Serving the Wider Coastal Community

blocks.html: While San Pedro and Palos Verdes are central to who we are, we proudly welcome customers from across California and beyond. People come to us from Carson, San Pedro, Wilmington, Westchester, Rancho Palos Verdes, Mar Vista, Del Rey, Lomita, Palos Verdes Estates, Playa Vista, Marina Del Ray, Fox Hills, Rolling Hills Estates, Rolling Hills, and LAX and from much farther away, drawn by the chance to shop in a secure, comfortable, and genuinely accepting space. Visitors, locals, and adventurers all find a place at our counter.

blocks.html: We believe cannabis can bring communities together, easing socialization, providing medicinal relief, and offering options that suit a wide range of needs. Pioneering legal access in this area was never just about opening a store, it was about elevating quality of life along this coast. Let us welcome you, share insight into our menu, and send you home happy. For recreational and medicinal marijuana along the San Pedro to Palos Verdes corridor, this is where potential and opportunity meet.
